ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift
ordered_steps.summary: Audit the translator schema drift before removing the legacy parser shim. The legacy shim currently masks schema drift in local smoke runs, so this audit must happen first to understand the full scope of schema issues.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift audit report documenting all translator schema inconsistencies

ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures
ordered_steps.summary: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures so the plan contract catches ordering regressions. The test plan_contract.py currently fails when new step ids are introduced without fixture updates.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated dependency-graph fixtures that pass plan_contract.py tests

ordered_steps.title: Enable dashboard summary behind kill switch
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the translated release-plan dashboard summary behind a kill switch after the schema is stable. The dashboard consumes the step-id schema produced by the translator and must not ship until fixtures reflect the new schema.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary enabled behind kill switch with canary validation

ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist
ordered_steps.summary: Update the operator runbook and launch checklist after the summary path is proven in canary. The runbook only stabilizes after the rollout and rollback shape are known.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated operator runbook and launch checklist

dependency_notes.reason: The translator schema audit must complete before the dashboard can be enabled, as the dashboard consumes the step-id schema
Dependency-graph fixtures must reflect the new schema before the dashboard summary can ship, otherwise the plan contract will fail on ordering regressions
The runbook only stabilizes after the rollout and rollback shape are known from canary validation of the dashboard summary

primary_risk.statement: The release dashboard will render incorrect step ordering to users if the schema and fixtures are not aligned before enabling the dashboard summary
mitigations: Enable dashboard summary behind a kill switch for controlled rollout
Validate schema stability before removing legacy parser shim
Use canary-only coverage to verify dashboard summary behavior before full rollout

assumption_ledger.note: No explicit timeline provided for when the legacy parser shim will be removed after schema audit
Specific success criteria for canary validation of dashboard summary are not documented
Schema drift is masked by legacy shim in local smoke runs as documented in repo_state.md
